title: GCL 并联电路的阶跃响应
statement: 图示 GCL 并联电路原来不带电，电流源为 2ε(t) A；R = 1 Ω（G = 1 S），L = 0.4 H，C = 0.5 F。
判断阻尼状态，求 i_C(0₊)，以及 t = π/4 s 时的电感电流 i_L 和电压 u。

questions.ask: t > 0 时电路的响应属于哪种情况？
choiceExplain: 临界阻尼要求 R 恰好等于并联电路的临界电阻 ½√(L/C)（特征方程有重根）。算一算它，看 R = 1 Ω 是否等于它。
把“电阻大 → 阻尼强”的串联结论搬到并联电路就会选这一项。并联电路的判据与串联相反：先算 ½√(L/C)，再想清楚 R 比它大意味着什么。
无阻尼对应并联电阻开路（G = 0），没有能量损耗；这里 G = 1 S，振荡会衰减。
questions.explain: 并联电路的判据与串联相反：R > ½√(L/C) 时欠阻尼。½√(0.4/0.5) ≈ 0.447 Ω，R = 1 Ω 大于它，所以欠阻尼。也可直接看特征方程 s² + s/(RC) + 1/(LC) = s² + 2s + 5 = 0 → s = −1 ± j2。

hints: GCL 并联电路是 RLC 串联电路的对偶：以 i_L 为变量，KCL 给出 LC·d²i_L/dt² + (L/R)·di_L/dt + i_L = i_s。
特征方程 s² + s/(RC) + 1/(LC) = 0；终值 i_L(∞) = 2 A（电感短路，电流源的电流全部流过电感）。
solution: **1. 方程。** 以 u 为并联电压：C·du/dt + u/R + i_L = 2，u = L·di_L/dt → LC·i_L″ + (L/R)·i_L′ + i_L = 2，即 0.2i_L″ + 0.4i_L′ + i_L = 2。

en.title: Step response of a parallel GCL circuit
statement: The parallel GCL circuit is initially uncharged and driven by the current source 2ε(t) A; R = 1 Ω (G = 1 S), L = 0.4 H, C = 0.5 F.
Classify the damping, find i_C(0+), and the inductor current i_L and the voltage u at t = π/4 s.

questions.ask: Which case describes the response for t > 0?
choiceExplain: Critical damping needs R exactly equal to the parallel critical resistance ½√(L/C) (a repeated root). Work it out and see whether R = 1 Ω equals it.
Carrying over the series idea “larger R → more damping” leads to this option. The parallel rule is the reverse of the series one: work out ½√(L/C), then think about what an R larger than that means.
Undamped means the parallel resistor is an open circuit (G = 0) with no loss; here G = 1 S, so the oscillation decays.
questions.explain: For a parallel circuit the test is reversed: it is underdamped when R > ½√(L/C). ½√(0.4/0.5) ≈ 0.447 Ω and R = 1 Ω is larger, so it is underdamped. Directly: s² + s/(RC) + 1/(LC) = s² + 2s + 5 = 0 → s = −1 ± j2.
u(0+) = u_C(0−) = 0, so i_R(0+) = 0; i_L(0+) = 0. The whole 2 A of the source flows into the capacitor: i_C(0+) = 2 A.
i_L = 2 − e^(−t)(2cos 2t + sin 2t) A. At t = π/4, cos(π/2) = 0 and sin(π/2) = 1: i_L = 2 − e^(−π/4) ≈ 1.544 A.
u = L·di_L/dt = 0.4 × 5e^(−t) sin 2t = 2e^(−t) sin 2t V. At t = π/4: u = 2e^(−π/4) ≈ 0.912 V.

hints: The parallel GCL circuit is the dual of the series RLC circuit: with i_L as the unknown, KCL gives LC·d²i_L/dt² + (L/R)·di_L/dt + i_L = i_s.
Characteristic equation s² + s/(RC) + 1/(LC) = 0; final value i_L(∞) = 2 A (the inductor is a short and takes all of the source current).
Fix the constants with i_L(0+) = 0 and di_L/dt(0+) = u(0+)/L = 0.
solution: **1. Equation.** With u the common voltage: C·du/dt + u/R + i_L = 2 and u = L·di_L/dt → LC·i_L″ + (L/R)·i_L′ + i_L = 2, i.e. 0.2i_L″ + 0.4i_L′ + i_L = 2.
**2. Roots.** s² + 2s + 5 = 0 → s = −1 ± j2, α = 1/(2RC) = 1 s⁻¹, ω_d = 2 rad/s → **underdamped**.
**4. Complete solution.** i_L = 2 + e^(−t)(A₁cos 2t + A₂sin 2t). i_L(0+) = 0 → A₁ = −2; i_L′(0+) = 0 → −A₁ + 2A₂ = 0 → A₂ = −1. i_L = 2 − e^(−t)(2cos 2t + sin 2t) A.
